command:
set -euo pipefail
listeners="$(lsof -nP -iTCP:46327 -sTCP:LISTEN)"
printf "%s\n" "$listeners"
[[ "$listeners" == *"100.64.0.14:46327 (LISTEN)"* ]]
[[ "$listeners" != *"*:46327 (LISTEN)"* ]]
for url in http://100.64.0.14:46327/ http://sweetmac14.sweet.home:46327/; do
  code="$(curl --noproxy "*" -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}" "$url")"
  printf "%s -> %s\n" "$url" "$code"
  [[ "$code" == "200" ]]
done
